clips.verdict: Dead at 0 views after 109h; a reading-a-letter bit is a slow setup that needs context a cold viewer lacks.
clips.worked: Narrator line states a clear, odd premise (a fan read a whole book on seduction to write a letter). Title names Jynxzi first.
clips.hurt: The hook 'WAIT FOR HIS LIFE ADVICE' is a mood label with no stake. The payoff is the advice itself, which depends on reading text aloud. 53s is too long for a letter. Narrator and hook both tease the same thing.

titles: Creator name first, then the setup in plain verbs. Never put the result in the title (Red Card, Copper, Hang On).
Sell the joke, not the trivia: 'Asks If This Dog Is Ever Sad' beats 'Japan's Most Popular Dog'. Use 1-2 emoji at the end and claim only what the audio backs up.
Use names the audience searches for (Speed, Kai, Ray, Jynxzi). Keep titles under 60 characters.
hooks: Write the hook as the stake or question the clip answers within 15s ('IF PALMER SCORES, STREAM ENDS'), never a mood label like 'WAIT FOR HIS LIFE ADVICE'.
The narrator states the promise and stops. Ban 'and then this happened'. If the narrator repeats the hook, cut one.
clip_picks: Pick moments with a one-line spoken premise: a bet, guess, countdown or question. Speed and Kai crossovers with athletes or celebrities come first.
Skip visual-only moments and crosstalk (fans chasing Kai, breed talk, a boxing clinch). If the transcript is not funny read aloud, skip it.
Listen to the whole clip before cutting. If an n-word can't be muted without killing the payoff, skip the clip. Two of six shipped with one.
length_and_pacing: Stop cutting every clip to 53s. Start ≤2s before the stake line and end ≤2s after the payoff. Most of these are 18-30s, and the breakouts are mostly 11-26s.
End on the payoff line and cut the trailing banter. A clean ending drives loops. Hand-fix burned-in captions on the key line.
posting: Post 1-2 clips a day within hours of the stream. Clips cut from streams days old compete with hundreds of other clippers.

0-15 views with n/a analytics after 107-162h points to a distribution problem. Check that the channel isn't limited, that uploads are not duplicates of other clippers' videos, and that the Shorts feed is serving them, before judging picks.
After 48h, judge each clip on 3s retention and share of views from the Shorts feed, and only once Studio shows those numbers.

money.why: The channel already makes Kai, Speed and Jynxzi clips with narrator hooks. Campaigns pay per view on approved clips, so they can earn before YPP, which is far off (18 of 10M Shorts views, 0 of 1000 subs).
money.first_step: Read N3on's campaign rules (allowed sources, payout basis, content limits, whether n-words are banned). Submit 2 short re-cut clips that meet them. Then look for other creators' open clipping programs.

money.why: Speed bets and Jynxzi rank guesses are repeatable formats. Compilations of 8-10 min can collect watch time and subs that Shorts at 0 subs are not getting.
money.first_step: After 5 clean Speed or Jynxzi clips are cut tight, assemble one 'every bet Speed lost this week' video and link it from the Shorts.

money.why: Viewers of Jynxzi's Rainbow Six clips care about gaming gear. Affiliate links in descriptions cost nothing and need no subscriber minimum, but they only pay once there are views.
money.first_step: Sign up for one gaming-gear affiliate program, check its terms on channel size, and add a link to the Jynxzi R6 clip descriptions.

money.why: The lower fan-funding tier needs 500 subs and 3M Shorts views, so it's the first reachable milestone. It's not a near-term income source.
money.first_step: Track subs and Shorts views weekly against 500 subs / 3M views, and add a pinned 'follow for same-day recaps' call to action on each clip.

Pull or re-edit the Kai/Ray and Adin clips to mute the n-words, or delete them. Then re-check the other four for slurs.
Re-cut the Speed vs Palmer and Jynxzi rank clips to 18-30s, ending on the payoff, with new stake hooks and spoiler-free titles.
Set up a same-day pipeline: pick 1-2 Speed or Kai bet/guess/question moments from a live stream and post within hours.
Apply to the N3on campaign terms with two clean, tight clips and check what the payout rules require.
